```{ojs pbdata-manifest}
//| output: false
// host pages (e.g. Astro embedding) may set window.PEEKBANK_DATA_BASE to an
// absolute URL for the slices/ directory; standalone pages use the relative
// default
DATA_BASE = (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.PEEKBANK_DATA_BASE) || "slices/"

manifest = d3.json(`${DATA_BASE}manifest.json`)
datasetNames = manifest.datasets.map((d) => d.name)

// display datasets by citation (team preference), disambiguating
// duplicate shortcites with the internal name; data tables keep the
// internal dataset_name, which is the key peekbankr users need
datasetLabel = {
  const counts = d3.rollup(manifest.datasets, (v) => v.length,
    (d) => d.shortcite ?? d.name);
  const m = new Map(manifest.datasets.map((d) => {
    const cite = d.shortcite ?? d.name;
    return [d.name, counts.get(cite) > 1 ? `${cite} · ${d.name}` : cite];
  }));
  return (name) => m.get(name) ?? name;
}

// Plot color options for charts coloured by dataset. A dataset starts from
// the colour at its position in the explorer's pool of datasets, so it keeps
// it while others are toggled, and only moves on when that colour is taken
// (which cannot happen in a pool of nine or fewer). Tableau10 without
// its grey has nine colours, so past that every line is grey and the
// tooltip names it.
datasetPalette = d3.schemeTableau10.slice(0, 9)

function datasetColor(names, pool = datasetNames) {
  const shown = new Set(names);
  const domain = pool.filter((d) => shown.has(d));
  if (domain.length > datasetPalette.length) {
    return { domain, range: domain.map(() => "#9ca3af"), legend: false };
  }
  const taken = new Set();
  const range = domain.map((name) => {
    let i = pool.indexOf(name) % datasetPalette.length;
    while (taken.has(i)) i = (i + 1) % datasetPalette.length;
    taken.add(i);
    return datasetPalette[i];
  });
  return { domain, range, legend: true, label: "Dataset", tickFormat: datasetLabel };
}

// the compact "All" switch beside a dataset list
function allToggle() {
  const toggle = Inputs.toggle({ label: "All", value: false });
  toggle.classList.add("viz-all");
  return toggle;
}

// called by each explorer's first chart: the explorer stays hidden behind
// the spinner until then and fades in whole, rather than control by control
function markReady() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".pb-spinner").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  document.querySelector(".viz-layout")?.classList.add("viz-ready");
}

// with no dataset selected there is nothing to draw, so the explorer says
// that instead of showing empty or broken charts (styled in theme.scss)
noDatasets = {
  const empty = active_datasets.length === 0;
  document.querySelector(".viz-main")?.classList.toggle("viz-empty", empty);
  return empty;
}

sliceCache = new Map()

async function loadSlice(name) {
  if (!sliceCache.has(name)) {
    sliceCache.set(name, await d3.json(`${DATA_BASE}datasets/${name}.json`));
  }
  return sliceCache.get(name);
}

// flatten selected slices into one row per trial administration:
// {dataset, aid, tid, t0, runs, age, subject, word, distractor, vanilla,
//  excluded, trial_order}
function buildRows(slices, opts = {}) {
  const {
    ageLo = 0, ageHi = 999, words = null, includeExcluded = true,
    collapseWords = false,
  } = opts;
  const wordSet = words ? new Set(words) : null;
  const rows = [];
  for (const s of slices) {
    const adminById = new Map(s.admins.map((a) => [a[0], a]));
    const ttById = new Map(s.trial_types.map((t) => [t[0], t]));
    const trialById = new Map(s.trials.map((t) => [t[0], t]));
    for (const [aid, tid, t0, runs] of s.runs) {
      const admin = adminById.get(aid);
      if (!admin || admin[1] == null || admin[1] < ageLo || admin[1] > ageHi) continue;
      const trial = trialById.get(tid);
      if (!trial) continue;
      if (!includeExcluded && trial[3] === 1) continue;
      const tt = ttById.get(trial[2]);
      if (!tt) continue;
      if (wordSet && !wordSet.has(tt[1])) continue;
      rows.push({
        dataset: s.dataset.name, aid, tid, t0, runs,
        age: admin[1], subject: admin[2],
        word: collapseWords ? "All" : tt[1], distractor: tt[2],
        vanilla: tt[4] === 1, excluded: trial[3] === 1,
        trial_order: trial[1],
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}

// mean accuracy within [wLo, wHi] for one trial's runs (or null if no
// target/distractor samples in the window)
function windowAccuracy(t0, runs, wLo, wHi) {
  let t = t0, n = 0, p = 0;
  for (const [aoi, len] of runs) {
    for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
      if (t < wLo || t > wHi || aoi > 1) continue;
      n += 1;
      if (aoi === 0) p += 1;
    }
  }
  return n > 0 ? p / n : null;
}

wordsOf = (slices) => {
  const w = new Set();
  for (const s of slices) for (const tt of s.trial_types) {
    if (tt[1] != null) w.add(tt[1]);
  }
  return Array.from(w).sort();
}
```
